abi.name: fs_open
abi.doc: open(path, mode) -> handle >= 0, or -1; mode is r/w/a

abi.name: fs_read
abi.doc: read(handle, buf, n) -> bytes read into buf, 0 at EOF, -1 on error

abi.name: fs_write
abi.doc: write(handle, buf, n) -> bytes written, -1 on error

abi.name: fs_list
abi.doc: list(path, buf, n) -> bytes the listing needs; names newline-separated, a directory ends in '/', or -1

abi.name: fs_error
abi.doc: error() -> the errno of the last failed call, or 0
